explanation: It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and 0 at D1 whenever the agent has been choosing a1. At D1 during a run of a2 choices it fires: about 0 on the first one or two trials of the run, then rising to 4-7 and reaching 8-10 as the run gets longer, highest after an unrewarded trial and later in the episode (around trials 65-90), and staying low (about 1) early in the episode (before trial 25).
